record.context_brief: Forward paths across multiple vertex orderings
record.original_question: For a digraph D and a vertex ordering L, call a directed path forward in L if its vertices appear in the same order as the orientation of the path. What is the smallest integer k such that every digraph D admits k vertex orderings L_1, ..., L_k with the property that for every two distinct vertices v_i and v_j, either some ordering L_ℓ contains a forward path from v_i to v_j or some ordering L_ℓ contains a forward path from v_j to v_i?

evidence.quote: Question : What is the minimal k such that for every digraph D there exists enumerations L1, . . . , Lk with for every vi ̸= vj ∈ V(D) either there is a forward path from vi to vj in some Ll or there is a forward path from vj to vi in some Ll .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D=(V,A)$ be a finite digraph. A linear ordering (enumeration) $L$ of $V$ is a bijection from $V$ to $\{1,2,\dots,|V|\}$. A directed path $v_{i_1}\to v_{i_2}\to\cdots\to v_{i_r}$ in $D$ is said to be forward in $L$ if $L(v_{i_1})<L(v_{i_2})<\cdots<L(v_{i_r})$, i.e., its vertices appear in $L$ in the same order as the orientation of the path.

A family of orderings $L_1,\dots,L_k$ of $V(D)$ is called a forward cover of $D$ if for every pair of distinct vertices $u,v\in V(D)$ there exists an index $\ell\in\{1,\dots,k\}$ such that $L_\ell$ contains a forward path from $u$ to $v$, or there exists an index $\ell'\in\{1,\dots,k\}$ such that $L_{\ell'}$ contains a forward path from $v$ to $u$.

Determine the smallest integer $k$ (if any) such that every digraph $D$ admits a forward cover of size $k$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on "forward covers" of digraphs poses this exact question and conjectures that every strong digraph on n vertices admits a forward cover of size O(log n); the conjecture is established for bi-oriented graphs, but the general problem (and in particular whether a constant k suffices, or any tight bound) appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Forward covers of digraphs (HAL preprint)
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture that every strong digraph on n vertices has an O(log n) size forward cover; established for bi-oriented graphs; existence of O(log n) connected forward cover remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The minimal-size forward cover problem is studied and remains open in general; only partial results (e.g. bi-oriented graphs) are known.
